{{Short description|US women's golf tournament, 1937–1972}} {{Use American English|date=June 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=December 2024}} {{about|the women's major golf championship played from 1937 to 1966 and again in 1972|the regular (non-major) golf tournament played from 1990 to 1999|Mercury Titleholders Championship|the season-ending tournament on the LPGA Tour played since 2011|CME Group Titleholders}} The '''Titleholders Championship''' was a women's [[golf]] tournament played from in 1937 to 1966 and again in 1972. It was later designated a [[Women's major golf championships|major championship]] by the [[LPGA Tour]]. ==History== The Titleholders Championship was founded in 1937. Like the [[Masters Tournament]] for men, which began a few years earlier, it was played in [[Augusta, Georgia]], but at [[Augusta Country Club]], not at the adjacent [[Augusta National Golf Club]]. The winners of various amateur and professional events were invited to take part, although most of the competitors were amateurs. There were very few women professionals at the time and most earned their living as club or teaching professionals. The Titleholders itself did not offer prize money until 1948, when a prize fund of $600 was introduced, with half of the money going to the professional placing highest in the event. The tournament was discontinued after November [[1966 LPGA Tour|1966]],{{cite news |url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=pfBRAAAAIBAJ&sjid=YXQDAAAAIBAJ&pg=3151%2C4907064 |work=St. Petersburg Times |location=Florida |agency=Associated Press |title=Whitworth rules Titleholders |date=November 28, 1966 |page=4C}} but was revived for one year in [[1972 LPGA Tour|1972]], when it was played in May at the [[Pine Needles Lodge and Golf Club]] in [[Southern Pines, North Carolina]].{{cite news |url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=UsVaAAAAIBAJ&sjid=JGEDAAAAIBAJ&pg=7054%2C4293759 |work=St. Petersburg Times |location=Florida |agency=Associated Press |title=Palmer shreds Titleholders with 283 win |date=May 30, 1972 |page=7C |archive-date=October 31, 2023 |access-date=December 23, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231031115816/https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=UsVaAAAAIBAJ&sjid=JGEDAAAAIBAJ&pg=7054,4293759 |url-status=live }} All of these stagings are now recognized as major championships by the [[LPGA]], even though the organization was not founded until 1950. ==Winners== {{See also|List of Titleholders Championship champions}} {| class=wikitable !Year!!Winner!!Country!!Score!!Runner(s)-up!!Winners'
